operation_details.item: The campaign was originally planned to launch in June.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the campaign coming together this week?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It’s in good shape. We originally planned to launch in June, but we’ve moved it to July.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a sensible adjustment. Did the extra time help with the creative?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the delay allowed us to finish the new creative instead of rushing it out.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great. Is the July timing settled now?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the July launch date is locked in the campaign calendar.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only the original June launch plan and retain the current July plan and its rationale.
